change_scope: v5.3: switched 00_README/run_all_tests.py from `unittest discover` to `pytest` (recovers 27 previously-invisible tests in 19_Kreissack_Arc/test_pov_integration_v19.py). Regenerated DAY13_POV_ACCESS_MATRIX_v3.4.csv and closed D13-04's Selene/Dante clauses against screenplay text already active (no rewrites needed). Ratified Raven's noncombat exception (D13-03) as final canon -- finale_flow.py and R6.3 already matched it. Fixed Steffan's ST6.3 G-damage ambiguity (D13-09). Hardened two tautological tests; surfaced two real stale Fanservice entries (FS-CRYSTAL-C3-2, FS-RAVEN-R3-2, tied to the v4.7 relationship-canon clarification), tracked as a documented allowlist rather than silently passing/failing. v5.4: author-decided the two remaining pack-wide open items from the drafted options. D13-05 resolved: clearance authority ratified as deliberately impersonal (no named office/person); zone adjacency ratified as a hub topology (Z1 reaches Z0/Z4 by corridor, Z2/Z3 only by data/command line, never a door). D13-06 resolved: ratified the already-observed support-cast pattern (Angel/Ren/Plug default trio; Crystal/Mara/Ari in their own specialties) plus three testable constraints; constraint (iii) (G-credit never reassigned off the selected pilot) is now enforced by a new regression test, test_support_cast_canon_v54.py, verified against a real injected violation before being accepted. v5.5: closed the one remaining item from `DAY13_ACCESS_AND_BRANCHING_v3.5.md`'s decisions list -- Dante's and Selene's active text already stated retry-from-checkpoint on a failed G strike; Raven's cleared/combat branch did not. Appended one sentence to Raven's R6.3 (no line-number shift) giving his combat branch the same retry-from-checkpoint behavior, and stating explicitly that his noncombat branch's failed/withheld map is final for that attempt rather than retried -- a deliberate difference in kind, not an oversight. No other campaign needed this (only Dante/Selene/Raven were ever flagged ambiguous here). This closes every pack-wide Day-13 open item. v5.6: extended the review into 29_Character_Art/ and 26_Background_Registry/, neither of which had been audited before. Added CHR-TES (Tessa Kade) to Character_Render_Prompts_v1.0 -- a recurring named character with her own romance-flag branch in Ren's campaign (`connection=tessa`) who had no render prompt despite the registry claiming full cast coverage; scope line corrected from 23 to 24 characters. Verified background_states.csv against BACKGROUND_CATALOG.md and scene_background_bindings.csv by direct cross-check (not by trusting the docs): all 160 catalog code+state combinations have a matching non-empty generation_prompt, and all 449 scene bindings resolve to real catalog entries -- test_background_registry.py re-run live, 4/4 pass. Checked the 12 legacy Fanservice proposal-only scene cards (S1-S12, Spicy_and_Fanservice_Scene_Cards_v0.2.md) against the 65 active-script tags: content ceiling matches (implied intimacy/fade-to-black, no anatomical description); overlapping pairings/titles with active scenes (e.g. S1/S12 vs. active Ari-Mara, S2/S10 vs. active Lyra-Steffan and ensemble pool scenes) are already self-flagged by the cards' own `may duplicate or conflict with active scenes` note -- no new issue found, this item is closed. No regressions; 424/424 tests still pass. v5.7: discovered that `26_Background_Registry/scene_background_bindings.csv` -- the file underlying the v5.6 staging-provisional list -- was itself bound to stale script versions: all 18 referenced screenplay files were superseded revisions (e.g. Lyra v0.5 vs. active v0.8, Crystal v0.7 vs. active v0.10, Raven v0.6 vs. active v0.9; confirmed by direct line-count and line-content diff, not by assumption). Regenerated the file from scratch by parsing the 18 actually-active scripts directly (scene headings, slugline detection, and inline `[BG: ...]` tags, including `STAGING PROVISIONAL` markers and `->` montage chains). Verified against `test_background_registry.py` (4/4 pass, re-run live) and spot-checked several rows against the active files by hand. Per-directory staging-provisional counts matched the old (stale) file exactly (e.g. 42/42 for the Ari chapters, 18/18 for Steffan), which is why the headline count barely moved -- confirming the underlying scene structure is stable across revisions even though the old line numbers and scene text were wrong. New totals: 112 `staging-provisional` + 10 `source-prose-montage` = 122 scenes without an explicit slugline (previously miscounted as 1 montage instead of 10, since the old generator only flagged one chain). Corrected list delivered to the author. `background_registry.json`'s `source_scenes`/`scene_count`/`inferred_uses` fields were deliberately left untouched -- they reference the same stale script versions and are a separate, still-open item (see unapproved_decisions); fixing them was out of scope for this pass since their `inferred_uses` derivation logic is undocumented and not safely reproducible without guessing. 424/424 tests still pass; no other files touched. v5.8: author reviewed the corrected 122-scene list and ratified all of it as-is. `scene_background_bindings.csv` now carries an `author_ratified` column (`v5.8` on the 122 previously-provisional/montage rows). This is approval of the chosen background per scene, not a claim that the underlying prose now contains an explicit slugline -- the `binding` column and the matching inline `STAGING PROVISIONAL` tags in the screenplay files stay as-is since they record a true fact about the source text, unaffected by ratifying the location choice. No script-editor review is required for these 122 scenes before image production. 424/424 tests still pass.
